title: Official talk
job: Parse a sign, a tannoy and a counter
verifiedBy: Claude Opus 5 — LLM review, authorised by repo owner

allowedTenses: present indicative, for the announcement itself and after si informa che
the Lei imperative, L4-M1's, in si rivolga, si accomodi, compili and firmi — L4-M5's mood is pointed at, not re-opened
the bare infinitive after si prega di and after è vietato
impersonal si plus a present verb, L3-M8's, widened here from what one does to what one is asked to do

rules.text: THE IMPERSONAL-FORMAL CLUSTER, WHICH IS ONE SYSTEM AND NOT FIVE PHRASES. si prega di plus an infinitive, è vietato plus an infinitive, si informa che plus a plain clause, and the Lei imperative L4-M1 taught (si rivolga, si accomodi, compili, firmi) finally standing in the place it comes from. L3-M8 opened the impersonal si at a counter and said what ONE DOES — si paga alla cassa. This module widens the same si to what ONE IS ASKED TO DO, and that is the whole grammatical step.

THIS IS A RECEPTION MODULE BEFORE IT IS A PRODUCTION ONE. The job is to parse a tannoy and a sign, not to compose one. The register has a grammar of its own and it is worth naming: it prefers the NOUN to the verb (Documento, prego), it prefers the IMPERSONAL to the second person, and it is not archaic — it is what is printed on the sign this year. A learner who hears it as quaint will answer in the friendliest Italian they own, which is the one move this module exists to prevent.

si prega di IS NOT PLEASE. It is a whole impersonal clause meaning one is requested to, and per favore — L1-M8's row — never appears on a sign. Two more mismatches ride with it. English officialdom names the PASSENGER (passengers are requested to remain behind the line) and Italian names the ACTION, so a learner listening for a word meaning you will not hear one and the announcement will pass them by. And si prega DI takes a di where è vietato takes none: si prega di non fumare, è vietato fumare.

prego DOES FOUR JOBS AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS TAUGHT ELSEWHERE. L1-M10's row is what a learner is shown when they tap it, and it is the you-are-welcome job. The other three are here: please do (Posso? Prego), after you at a door, and — the one that matters at a counter — next please, the clerk waving you forward. When somebody behind glass says Prego, they are not thanking you; they are asking what you want.

WHAT THIS MODULE POINTS AT AND DOES NOT OPEN. si rivolga and si accomodi are present congiuntivo forms doing duty as commands — L4-M5 named that mood two modules ago and it is not re-derived here, so treat them as fixed counter words. The venire passive (viene effettuato) belongs to fixed announcement phrases and the passive as a system is L5's. And nothing ceremonial belongs here: no toasts, no speeches, no condolences. This is the register of a queue, not of an occasion.

sentences.display: Si prega di non fumare in sala d'attesa
sentences.cue: Smoking is not permitted in the waiting room
sentences.literal: One begs of not to-smoke in room of-wait

words.cue: one is requested to, please (on a sign)
words.note: Not the word for please. It is an impersonal clause — one is requested to — and the di in front of the infinitive is compulsory.
One block, elision and all, and it goes without an article after in: in sala d'attesa, the way English says in hospital.

sentences.trap: si prega di is not please. per favore is what you say to a person standing in front of you; a sign has nobody to be polite to and speaks impersonally.
sentences.sound: see PREH-ga dee non foo-MA-re een SA-la dat-TEH-za. d'attesa runs together as one word, dat-TEH-za.

variations.display: Si prega di non fumare in stazione
variations.cue: Smoking is not permitted in the station
variations.changed: the whole building instead of one room

variations.display: Si prega di aspettare in sala d'attesa
variations.cue: Please wait in the waiting room
variations.changed: an instruction instead of a prohibition

variations.display: Si prega di non parlare in sala d'attesa
variations.cue: Please do not talk in the waiting room
variations.changed: the forbidden action

mistake.display: Per favore non fumare in sala d'attesa
mistake.why: per favore is addressed to somebody. A sign addresses nobody in particular, so it reaches for si prega di, and a learner who writes per favore has written a note, not a notice.

sentences.usage: Reading the sign above the seats while you wait for a train.
sentences.mnemonic: si prega DI — the di is part of the phrase.

sentences.display: Attenzione, il treno è in ritardo di venti minuti
sentences.cue: Attention: the train is twenty minutes late
sentences.literal: Attention, the train is in delay of twenty minutes

words.note: The opening word of every announcement and every warning sign. Alone it means watch out; in front of a clause it just means listen.
The noun behind L4-M2's in ritardo. A station counts it in minutes: un ritardo di venti minuti.

sentences.trap: The delay is measured with di and not with per: in ritardo di venti minuti. And the phrase stays in ritardo — L4-M2's row — never a ritardo.
sentences.sound: at-ten-TSYO-ne, eel TREH-no eh een ree-TAR-do dee VEN-tee mee-NOO-tee. The zi of attenzione is a ts, at-ten-TSYO-ne.

variations.display: Attenzione, il treno è in ritardo di dieci minuti
variations.cue: Attention: the train is ten minutes late
variations.changed: how long you are waiting

variations.display: Il treno ha un ritardo di venti minuti
variations.cue: The train has a delay of twenty minutes
variations.changed: the noun on its own, which is how the board writes it

variations.display: Attenzione, il treno arriva al binario tre
variations.cue: Attention: the train arrives at platform three
variations.changed: good news instead of bad

mistake.display: Attenzione, il treno è tardi di venti minuti
mistake.why: tardi is late in the day. A service running behind its timetable is in ritardo, and that is the only phrase a station uses.

sentences.usage: Standing on the platform working out whether you have time for a coffee.
sentences.mnemonic: in ritardo DI so many minutes.

sentences.display: È vietato fumare in tutta la stazione
sentences.cue: Smoking is forbidden throughout the station
sentences.literal: It-is forbidden to-smoke in all the station

words.note: Takes a bare infinitive and NO di, unlike si prega di. On a sign the è is usually dropped altogether: Vietato fumare.
The feminine of L3-M9's tutto, first shown here. With an article behind it it means the whole of one thing: in tutta la stazione.

sentences.trap: No di after è vietato. si prega DI fumare would be wrong the other way round: one phrase takes the di and the other refuses it.
sentences.sound: eh vye-TA-to foo-MA-re een TOOT-ta la sta-TSYO-ne. vietato is four syllables, vye-TA-to.

variations.display: È vietato fumare in ufficio
variations.cue: Smoking is forbidden in the office
variations.changed: the place the ban covers

variations.display: Vietato fumare
variations.cue: No smoking
variations.changed: the copula dropped, which is what the sign itself says

variations.display: È vietato entrare in sala d'attesa
variations.cue: Entry to the waiting room is forbidden
variations.changed: the forbidden action

mistake.display: È vietato di fumare in tutta la stazione
mistake.why: è vietato takes no di. The pair is worth memorising together: si prega di fumare has the di, è vietato fumare has none.

sentences.usage: Reading the red sign on the concourse wall.
sentences.mnemonic: Vietato plus the bare verb, no di.

sentences.display: Si rivolga allo sportello numero due
sentences.cue: Please go to counter number two
sentences.literal: Oneself turn to-the counter number two

words.note: A fixed counter word: L4-M1's polite imperative of rivolgersi. It sends you somewhere else, and the si belongs to the verb rather than to the impersonal.

words.cue: to the (before s plus consonant, and z)
words.note: a plus lo. Italian uses lo, not il, in front of sportello and studio, so the joined form is allo sportello.
The window with a person behind it, in a bank, a post office or a station. Not a shop counter, which is a banco.

sentences.trap: si rivolga is an ORDER, not a report. si rivolge, with an e, would say that somebody is going to the counter, which is not what the clerk means.
sentences.sound: see ree-VOL-ga AL-lo spor-TEL-lo NOO-me-ro DOO-e. The gl of rivolga is a hard g, ree-VOL-ga, not the ly of figlio.

variations.display: Si rivolga allo sportello numero tre
variations.cue: Please go to counter number three
variations.changed: the window you are sent to

variations.display: Si rivolga al collega
variations.cue: Please speak to my colleague
variations.changed: a person instead of a window

variations.display: Si rivolga allo sportello, per favore
variations.cue: Please go to the counter
variations.changed: the number dropped and a courtesy added

mistake.display: Si rivolge allo sportello numero due
mistake.why: The polite command ends in -a. si rivolge is the plain present and reports what somebody does; the clerk is telling you to move.

sentences.usage: Being sent away from the wrong window in a post office.
sentences.mnemonic: Si rivolgA is an order; si rivolgE is a report.

sentences.display: In caso di emergenza, si rivolga al personale
sentences.cue: In case of emergency, speak to a member of staff
sentences.literal: In case of emergency, oneself turn to-the staff

words.cue: in case of, in the event of
words.note: Takes a BARE noun with no article: in caso di emergenza, in caso di ritardo. In caso dell-anything is a learner's sentence, not a sign.
Feminine, and the word on every green exit sign. uscita di emergenza is the emergency exit, again with no article between the two nouns.
Singular in Italian where English is plural: il personale is all the staff together, so the verb behind it is singular too.

sentences.trap: in caso di takes no article. English says in case of an emergency and Italian says in caso di emergenza, with nothing between di and the noun.
sentences.sound: een KA-zo dee e-mer-JEN-tsa, see ree-VOL-ga al per-so-NA-le. emergenza ends -JEN-tsa, with the same ts as attenzione.

variations.display: In caso di ritardo, si rivolga al personale
variations.cue: In case of delay, speak to a member of staff
variations.changed: the thing that has gone wrong

variations.display: In caso di emergenza, si rivolga allo sportello
variations.cue: In case of emergency, go to the counter
variations.changed: where you are sent

variations.display: Si rivolga al personale in caso di emergenza
variations.cue: Speak to a member of staff in case of emergency
variations.changed: the frame moved to the back

mistake.display: In caso di una emergenza, si rivolga al personale
mistake.why: The article is what gives it away as a translation. Italian signs write in caso di emergenza, in caso di ritardo, in caso di sciopero — bare noun every time.

sentences.usage: Reading the laminated card on the back of a seat.
sentences.mnemonic: in caso di plus a naked noun.

sentences.display: Compili la richiesta e firmi qui
sentences.cue: Fill in the request and sign here
sentences.literal: Fill-in the request and sign here

words.note: L4-M1's polite imperative of compilare, the verb for filling in a form. It pairs with L3-M8's firmi, and the two always travel together.
The piece of paper you ask WITH, where L3-M8's modulo is the blank form itself. A counter uses both words for the same sheet.

sentences.trap: Both verbs stay in the same register. compila la richiesta e firmi mixes a friend and a stranger in one sentence, and a clerk never does that.
sentences.sound: kom-PEE-lee la ree-KYES-ta e FEER-mee kwee. compili is stressed on the first i, kom-PEE-lee.

variations.display: Compili il modulo e firmi qui
variations.cue: Fill in the form and sign here
variations.changed: L3-M8's word for the same sheet

variations.display: Compili la richiesta, per favore
variations.cue: Fill in the request, please
variations.changed: the signature left for later

variations.display: Compili la richiesta e poi firmi
variations.cue: Fill in the request and then sign
variations.changed: the order of the two jobs spelled out

mistake.display: Compila la richiesta e firmi qui
mistake.why: compila is the tu form and firmi is the polite one, so the sentence changes who it is talking to halfway through. At a counter both are polite.

sentences.usage: Being handed a pen and a sheet of paper across a window.
sentences.mnemonic: compili and firmi — one register, both verbs.

sentences.display: Ho un appuntamento, ma non ho la prenotazione
sentences.cue: I have an appointment, but I do not have the booking
sentences.literal: I-have an appointment, but not I-have the booking

words.note: A slot with a person: a doctor, an office, an official. Prendere un appuntamento is to make one, and it is not a romantic word by itself.
A held place: a table, a seat, a room. The verb behind it is prenotare, and a counter will ask for the number rather than the paper.

sentences.trap: The two are not interchangeable. An appuntamento is time with somebody; a prenotazione is a place held for you, and asking for the wrong one at a window gets you sent away.
sentences.sound: o oon ap-poon-ta-MEN-to, ma non o la pre-no-ta-TSYO-ne. Both are long words with the stress on the second-last syllable.

variations.display: Ho un appuntamento per oggi
variations.cue: I have an appointment for today
variations.changed: the booking dropped and a day added

variations.display: Ho la prenotazione, ma non ho un appuntamento
variations.cue: I have the booking, but I do not have an appointment
variations.changed: the two halves swapped

variations.display: Ho un appuntamento, ma non ho il documento
variations.cue: I have an appointment, but I do not have my ID
variations.changed: the thing you are missing

mistake.display: Ho un appuntamento, ma non ho la reservazione
mistake.why: reservazione is not an Italian word. The booking is a prenotazione, from prenotare, and the invented cognate marks you out immediately.

sentences.usage: Explaining yourself at a window that wants a number you were never given.
sentences.mnemonic: prenotazione holds a place; appuntamento holds a time.

sentences.display: Si informa che oggi lo sportello è chiuso
sentences.cue: Please be advised that the counter is closed today
sentences.literal: One informs that today the counter is closed

words.cue: it is announced that, please be advised
words.note: The announcing twin of si prega di: it states a fact rather than asking for something, and the che behind it takes an ordinary indicative clause.
The participle of chiudere, L4-M1's verb, used as an adjective. It agrees: lo sportello è chiuso, la stazione è chiusa.

sentences.trap: si informa che keeps the INDICATIVE. The congiuntivo L4-M5 taught belongs behind doubt, and an announcement is never in doubt about its own notice.
sentences.sound: see een-FOR-ma ke OJ-jee lo spor-TEL-lo eh KYOO-zo. chiuso is KYOO-zo, with a buzzing s.

variations.display: Si informa che oggi lo sportello è aperto
variations.cue: Please be advised that the counter is open today
variations.changed: the news reversed

variations.display: Si informa che lo sportello è chiuso
variations.cue: Please be advised that the counter is closed
variations.changed: the day left out, as a permanent notice would

variations.display: Oggi lo sportello è chiuso
variations.cue: The counter is closed today
variations.changed: the announcing frame stripped off, which is how you would tell a friend

mistake.display: Si informa che oggi lo sportello sia chiuso
mistake.why: sia is the mood of doubt. si informa che announces something the office knows for certain, so the verb stays è.

sentences.usage: Reading the printed sheet taped to the glass.
sentences.mnemonic: si informa che — then a plain fact.

sentences.display: C'è una coda lunga, ma lo sportello è aperto
sentences.cue: There is a long queue, but the counter is open
sentences.literal: There-is a queue long, but the counter is open

words.note: Literally a tail. fila is the other everyday word for the same thing, and fare la coda is to queue up.
The participle of aprire used as an adjective, and the opposite of chiuso. It agrees: lo sportello è aperto, la banca è aperta.

sentences.trap: A line of people is a coda or a fila. linea is a line on paper or a telephone line, and it is never used for a queue.
sentences.sound: cheh OO-na KO-da LOON-ga, ma lo spor-TEL-lo eh a-PEHR-to. coda has a plain o, KO-da.

variations.display: C'è una fila lunga allo sportello
variations.cue: There is a long queue at the counter
variations.changed: the other word for the same queue

variations.display: C'è una coda lunga, ma lo sportello è chiuso
variations.cue: There is a long queue, but the counter is closed
variations.changed: the worst possible combination

variations.display: Non c'è coda, lo sportello è aperto
variations.cue: There is no queue, the counter is open
variations.changed: the queue negated, and the article goes with it

mistake.display: C'è una linea lunga, ma lo sportello è aperto
mistake.why: linea is a drawn line or a phone line. People standing one behind another are una coda or una fila, never una linea.

sentences.usage: Reporting back to somebody who sent you to the post office.
sentences.mnemonic: coda is a tail of people.

sentences.display: Si accomodi, prego, è il suo turno
sentences.cue: Come through, please — it is your turn
sentences.literal: Oneself make-comfortable, please, is the your turn

words.cue: come in, take a seat, come through
words.note: The most useful counter word in the language. It covers come in, sit down, this way and go ahead, and only the situation says which.
Your place in the queue: è il suo turno, tocca a lei. It is also a work shift, which is the same idea of whose time it is.

sentences.trap: The word here is prego, not per favore. per favore asks for something; prego hands it over, and at a counter it means next please.
sentences.sound: see ak-KO-mo-dee, PREH-go, eh eel SOO-o TOOR-no. accomodi is stressed early, ak-KO-mo-dee.

variations.display: Si accomodi, prego
variations.cue: Come through, please
variations.changed: the reason left unsaid, which is how it is usually said

variations.display: Prego, è il suo turno
variations.cue: Please — it is your turn
variations.changed: the invitation carried by prego alone

variations.display: Si accomodi qui, prego
variations.cue: Take a seat here, please
variations.changed: a chair pointed at, which is the sit-down reading

mistake.display: Si accomodi, per favore, è il suo turno
mistake.why: per favore is a request and the clerk is not requesting anything. The word that waves you forward is prego, one of the four jobs it does.

sentences.usage: Being called from the waiting chairs to the window.
sentences.mnemonic: Prego calls you forward; per favore asks for something.
